title: Consolidate harness binary argument decoding without changing command behavior
goal: Vision: V-6. Reduce repeated parser implementations in harness frontends while preserving every argument, default, diagnostic, validation order, repeated flag and positional-prompt behavior.

reuse.searched: Audited all harness binary parsers, their existing argument compatibility tests, root harness_cli, gateway/ingress startup and existing helpers. Consolidates the identical take/value parsing and empty-required checks; gateway startup differences remain intact. No external implementation or dependency is needed.

evidence.source_lines: The six binary files and shared helper total 2775 -> 2711 physical Rust lines (-64), counting the full new helper. All six existing inline test modules are byte-identical.
evidence.tests: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-harness --bins: 41 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored; includes help, version, argument defaults, numeric failures, missing values, required-field ordering and prompt/scope parsing.
evidence.lint: cargo clippy --offline --locked -p susi-harness --bins -- -D warnings passed; cargo fmt --all --check and git diff --check passed.
evidence.behavior: Only shared argument extraction, typed number decoding and required-empty validation changed. Command grammars, runtime assembly, help, lifecycle and existing tests are unchanged. Number failure messages retain each frontend's original spelling and integer type inference.

limitations: Local isolated task; no external board messages, commit or push. Scope excludes harness MCP modules and does not establish the complete under-100k goal.
peer_review: Independent review found no behavior differences in SSE line normalization/selection, numeric diagnostics/order, probe validation/admission/error lifetime, or plane defaults. All new helpers counted.
